Database testing caught a real blocker: an existing validation trigger rejects the new recipe fields. That protection should stay; it needs an additive migration that accepts both the old and new content formats.

## Decision pending: TEACH-DEMO-RECIPES-2026-10-18@0.1.0
SYS-21 impact issue against main 2ad83bfce7d5c460f9f5f383a36491d9188de916. This is a bounded successor to the registered demo content/read contract, not approval to deploy. Owner ratification of the exact versions below is PENDING. Existing 0.1.0 source package remains immutable.

### Exact proposed revision
- TEACH-CON-C31 1.3.0 → 1.4.0: admit canonical Content schema 1.1.0 and frozen synthetic template version 1.1.0, retaining read/validation of exact immutable 1.0.0 packs.
- TEACH-CON-C41 1.2.0 → 1.3.0: existing ReadAssignedContentVersion response additionally admits exact PublicContent schema 1.1.0.
- TEACH-CON-C42 1.2.0 → 1.3.0: learner kitchen catalog, searchable/filterable recipe book, recipe detail/reference view; navigation to existing general handoff practice clearly not a recipe-specific graded challenge.
- Successor package TEACH-DEMO-RECIPES-2026-10-18@0.1.0 records this limited exception to the original frozen content/transport definitions. All other incorporated original definitions remain unchanged. Superseded contract copies, changelogs, approval provenance and dependent registration evidence must be preserved.

### Data and behavior boundary
Exactly three clearly fictional recipe records are immutable children of the existing organization-owned ContentPack version JSON. No new database, schema namespace, table, migration, entity owner or public operation. Each record contains unique id, title (max160 Unicode scalars), station(max80), servings(integer1..100), ingredients(1..30 text items each max500), steps(1..20 each max2000), reference(max1000). Existing plain-text safety, canonicalization, 64KiB bound and SHA256 exact-version binding apply. Titles identify fictional samples. Reference copy links only to the original general handoff practice.
The original three SINGLE_CHOICE blocks, expected answers, feedback, scoring, completion/participation meaning, assignment/session lifecycle, 15 API routes, seven served asset paths, capabilities and all security guards remain unchanged. Browsing recipes writes no progress or mastery. Managers gain no content-read capability. New admissions use the successor template only after registration/admission gates pass; old immutable content remains readable. No customer approval or real recipe licensing claim.

### Implementation impact
Content domain validator/public read projection and synthetic template factory; existing Organization admission composition selects the registered successor; existing client response codec accepts the two exact versions; client controller reads only own assigned content with exact pack/version/digest checks; kitchen/book/detail render read-only escaped content with search, station filter, clear, back, refresh and general-practice controls.
Current local work is unpromoted candidate UI/domain preparation. Active contract files and admission composition have not been changed. No new seed or runtime activation is authorized by this issue.

### Acceptance cases recorded before promotion
1. Validate old1.0 and new1.1 canonical content; reject extra/missing fields, duplicate IDs, malformed bounds/version, unsafe text, digest mismatch; freeze published recipe data.
2. Original handoff blocks/answers/feedback and completion counts remain byte-equivalent apart from fresh scoped identifiers.
3. Only own assigned exact-version content appears; foreign org/pack, malformed payload, manager or revoked-session access fails closed.
4. Kitchen, book, recipe detail and general-practice links connect; search/filter/no-match/clear/back/refresh and missing recipe recovery work without pretend persistence.
5. Existing learner answer/complete/readback, manager readback/reassignment/revocation, reset confirmation/cancel/partial failure and logout retain guarantees.
6. Automated/source checks plus actual cloud-browser desktop/mobile and keyboard evidence are labeled separately; unknowns never become blanket all-controls-working claims.
7. Regenerate source inventory, contract/governance evidence and version-bound test evidence after implementation. Preserve hosted-runtime disabled state.

### Excluded
Hosting/domain configuration, payment/upgrade, new providers, real customers, customer catalog policy, new learning/scoring semantics, certification/XP/mastery, deletion or security-setting changes.

It updates C31/C41/C42 and the content schema/template; the lesson, scoring, permissions, and 15 API routes stay unchanged.

This does not authorize hosting, spending, or live-database changes. UI and test preparation can continue while that approval is pending.
